rows.name: imap-backup
rows.reason: Imap-backup provides scheduled local Mbox exports plus restore/migration. Requires scheduled execution and credentials; restore needs UIDPLUS, and mirror mode propagates mailbox deletions.

rows.name: Fastmail
rows.reason: Individual plan documents owned domains, export, IMAP and optional JMAP. Higher price is no decisive violation without budget ceiling; delivery and recurring-export arrangement still need trials.

rows.name: MXroute
rows.reason: MXroute offers custom-domain mail, IMAP export and reputation-related retries. Entry plan shows $59/year for 10GB; setup knowledge is expected, and delivery statements remain provider claims.

rows.name: isync/mbsync with scheduled, retained Maildir copies
rows.reason: Scheduled isync/mbsync Maildir copies require IMAP/authentication, all-folder configuration, scheduling and retained snapshots. Sync can propagate deletions; live mirrors alone are insufficient recoverable copies. No configuration/restore executed; mail API optional.

rows.name: Proton Mail Free
rows.reason: Exclude Proton Free: mandatory owned-domain support requires a paid plan. Paid Proton is a different configuration and cannot silently replace the supplied Free candidate.

rows.name: Fastmail
rows.reason: Fastmail meets the owned-domain hosting and IMAP export requirements, and its documented JMAP API addresses the optional agent integration; its higher price is a tradeoff rather than a disqualifier.

rows.name: Fastmail Individual
rows.reason: Fastmail Individual documents custom domains, export and JMAP. $60/year or $6/month; ZIP export is per-folder, capped at 4GB. Optional API convenience does not override budget or delivery checks.

rows.name: Fastmail
rows.reason: Custom-domain email/IMAP portability includes a documented JMAP message API for optional agent integration. Individual's displayed annual price is $60/year, substantially above the cheapest options.

rows.name: Purelymail
rows.reason: Purelymail offers custom-domain hosting and documented IMAP export. Its $10/year simple plan has soft resource limits; delivery quality was not independently measured.

rows.name: Migadu Micro
rows.reason: Micro: $19/year, 5 GB, 200 incoming/day and 20 outgoing/day; custom-domain IMAP. Incoming excess can delay receipt. Mail-content API existence and Micro entitlement unverified.

rows.name: FastAPI
rows.reason: FastAPI constructs Python APIs, not operated custom-domain mail delivery/export. A wrapper still needs provider/backup infrastructure; optional API preference does not turn this unspecified construction into a replacement service.

rows.name: mailbox Standard
rows.reason: Standard offers €36/year custom-domain hosting, 20 GB and IMAP. Standalone Light lacks equivalent domain support. Delivery/restore remain untested; business administration documentation does not establish a personal mail API.

rows.name: Proton Mail Free
rows.reason: Proton Mail Free cannot host the user's owned domain: the supplied official guide explicitly requires a paid Proton plan for custom domains.

rows.name: FastAPI
rows.reason: Python HTTP API framework supplies no personal mailbox, custom-domain email hosting, delivery infrastructure or recurring mailbox exports. An optional API bonus does not make it a solution.

rows.name: Migadu
rows.reason: Custom-domain IMAP hosting with account-wide quotas. Micro costs $19/year: 5 GB, 200 incoming and 20 outgoing messages/day. Sustained overruns can impede delivery.

rows.name: Purelymail
rows.reason: Purelymail's $10/year entry plan is lowest among investigated providers, with domains/IMAP and soft limits. Delivery, archive fit and recurring exports untested; no mail API claimed.
